rules.source_quote: Solo travel. Any alcoholic beverage purchased while traveling on business without external clients present.
Team-only meals. Alcohol consumed at meals attended only by Northwind employees is not reimbursable.
In-room consumption. Alcohol purchased through hotel room service or mini-bars under any circumstances.
A per-person alcohol spend that does not exceed $50

Alcohol charges where the food portion of the receipt is minimal (less than 50% of the receipt total) will be reviewed for compliance and may be denied.
